searchText: I'm wondering, what'd be the impact on [EIP-7862](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7862) on zkEVM? I'm thinking, for provers who have multiple candidate blocks to create a proof for in each slot, this would be quite helpful, proving the MPT of the prev block, n-1, at the beginning of the slot with block n. So it def help provers/builders, at least those with multiple candidate blocks, but would it impact zkEVMs at all if, let's say, there's only one candidate block. We'd prove the MPT after the state transition of the block in n-1, in n, right at the beginning, instead of the post-state of the block in n at the end of execution.
